Name: Final Fantasy VII Bike for the Motorcycle Mod
Author: yehudirs
Description:
This mod replace the Motorcycle of the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953?tab=description]Motorcycle Mod - Continued[/url]" with the one made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/93785413]N0tSephiroth[/url] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29005?tab=description]Final Fantasy VII Bike[/url])


This is a Content Patcher version of the Final Fantasy VII Bike made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/93785413]N0tSephiroth[/url] and designed to be used with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953?tab=description]Motorcycle Mod[/url].

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Then download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953?tab=description]Motorcycle Mod - Continued[/url].
4. Finally, download and unzip this mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[u]Optional:[/u]
5. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to edit certain aspects of the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953?tab=description]Motorcycle Mod - Continued[/url].

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]

[size=3]I've only seen it slightly incompatible with the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url]" mod ([/size][size=3]It seems to affect the motorcycle as well, so you can pet and feed your bike xD. I don't know why, and it seems that it can only be corrected by the author of the "Horse Overhaul" mod)[/size]

[size=3]Thanks to[/size] the person who is continuing with the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27953?tab=description]Motorcycle Mod - Continued[/url]" by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3490737]CyanFire[/url]﻿
[/size][size=3]Thanks to the person who make the sprite and the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29005?tab=description]Final Fantasy VII Bike Horse Replacer[/url]﻿ mod by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/N0tSephiroth?gameId=1303]N0tSephiroth
